task: Implement Lattice Host Overflow so Codex can hand bounded overflow work to Claude Code when local agent capacity is scarce while Lattice keeps story, scope, receipt, evidence, and gate authority.
outcome: 用户运行 lattice host_status --host=claude-code --format=json 能看到 Claude Code overflow readiness；运行 lattice handoff_create --storyId=B-aa98 --fromHost=codex --toHost=claude-code --role=koala-review-quality --objective="review docs" --allowedPaths=README.md --requiredCommands="npm test" --format=json 能得到带 packId、packHash、baseSha、allowedPaths、successCriteria、authorityChanged=false、productionDone=false 的任务包；Claude Code 完成后运行 lattice handoff_receipt_submit --file=... --format=json 能看到 receipt status=accepted-local、scopeStatus=pass/stale/fail 和 nextAction。
facts: Lattice already has host_list/host_probe/capability_list plus handoff_create/inspect/accept/resume surfaces.
Existing handoff surfaces intentionally do not manufacture productionDone or verified receipts.
Codex and Claude Code are host runtimes; Lattice is the authority layer for story state, scope, receipt, evidence, and gates.
The user wants overflow when Codex agent scheduling is scarce, especially for bounded reviewer or independent implementation tasks.
constraints: Do not build a new agent runtime or require Mac App.
Do not auto-trust Claude Code output or auto-merge diffs.
Story/checklist state must be changed through Lattice CLI, not direct JSON edits.
External host results must be represented as local diagnostic receipts unless a future server authority verifies them.
Manual mode must work before supervised dispatch is trusted.
unknowns: Whether Claude Code CLI is installed on this machine is environment-dependent and must degrade to unavailable/warn.
Exact non-interactive Claude Code invocation is host/vendor-specific, so first release should keep supervised dispatch as conservative projection.
Receipt integration should be local and gate-visible without implying server authority.
